scope: Ordered current projection and source lifecycle
Full BRB/WHAM configuration composition at finite targets
verification.evidence_ceiling: Named geometry, lifecycle and configuration cases only; no arbitrary-input scientific correctness or release claim.
known_limitations: No experimental validation of source device constants, conductor area proxy or material magnetization is claimed.
Direct geometry/weight arrays can be mutated; cache content changes are detected, but mutation that desynchronizes parameterized geometry from its parameters is outside the supported contract.
Unknown **kwargs are permissive where inherited; no arbitrary keyword semantic claim.
Plotting/patch, simplify/clone, multiprocessing, electrodes and persistent sweeps are excluded or unresolved.
No scientific, experimental or licensing approval is claimed.

summary: Construct a signed two-face, sixteen-filament approximation of a rectangular permanent-ring cross-section.

identity.direction: ring geometry parameters to a weighted source object
identity.definition: Two radial faces each receive eight axial filament points and opposite default weights.
identity.model: Axisymmetric ideal circular filaments used as a geometry approximation.
identity.geometry: Rectangular cross-section in cylindrical R,Z coordinates with optional centroid rotation.
identity.coordinates: R,Z in metres; orientation in degrees; weights dimensionless; current in amperes.
identity.boundary: Resulting filament radii must remain nonnegative; active source/target coincidence remains singular.
assumptions: Width and height are finite and positive.
Default weights are eight -1 values followed by eight +1 values.
This object is not a material magnetization model.

outputs.name: source
outputs.description: Constructed MagnetRing object. Available properties/methods: rz_pts: Filament centers [m], (N,2); total_current: Weighted current [A], scalar
outputs.constraints: Field methods require a configured or supplied target mesh; geometry and lifecycle properties are those of the constructed object.

preconditions: Width and height are finite and positive.
Default weights are eight -1 values followed by eight +1 values.
supported: Signed geometry, transforms, current/weight mutation, mesh propagation, and lifecycle behavior.
excluded: Finite-wire magnetics, permeability/material response, electrodes, and unsupported simplify operations.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError is raised for invalid geometry, current, weights, mesh, or active-filament coincidence; simplify raises NotImplementedError.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError from a nonrepresentable child Green response propagates; failed parameterized updates restore prior geometry.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; construction and field evaluation are direct.
failure_semantics.partial_results: A failed constructor returns no source; atomic updates preserve the prior state.

example.description: Construct a default signed magnet-ring source.
example.code:
from scirel.electromagnetism import MagnetRing
r=MagnetRing()
assert r.npts == 16
example.expected: The source contains 16 filament points with the default signed two-face geometry.
